verses.original: לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי־ לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ā·ḏām ma·‘ar·ḵê- lêḇ Yah·weh ma·‘ă·nêh lā·šō·wn
verses.literal: The plans of the heart belong to man but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD
verses.literalPt: DO homem são as preparações do coração, mas do SENHOR a resposta da língua.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ דַּרְכֵי־ אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- dar·ḵê- ’îš zaḵ bə·‘ê·nāw wə·ṯō·ḵên rū·ḥō·wṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: All a man’s ways are pure in his own eyes but his motives are weighed out by the LORD
verses.literalPt: Todos os caminhos do homem são puros aos seus olhos, mas o SENHOR pesa o espírito.

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: gōl ’el- Yah·weh ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā wə·yik·kō·nū maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved
verses.literalPt: Confia ao SENHOR as tuas obras, e teus pensamentos serão estabelecidos.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־ רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōl pā·‘al Yah·weh lam·ma·‘ă·nê·hū wə·ḡam- rā·šā‘ lə·yō·wm rā·‘āh
verses.literal: The LORD has made everything for His purpose even the wicked for the day of disaster
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR fez todas as coisas para atender aos seus próprios desígnios, até o ímpio para o dia do mal.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ גְּבַהּ־ לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh kāl- gə·ḇah- lêḇ yāḏ lə·yāḏ lō yin·nā·qeh
verses.literal: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD be assured that . . . he will not go unpunished
verses.literalPt: Abominação é ao SENHOR todo o altivo de coração; não ficará impune mesmo de mãos postas.

verses.original: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ yə·ḵup·par ‘ā·wōn ū·ḇə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh sūr mê·rā‘
verses.literal: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil
verses.literalPt: Pela misericórdia e verdade a iniqüidade é perdoada, e pelo temor do SENHOR os homens se desviam do pecado.

verses.original: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ גַּם־ א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bir·ṣō·wṯ Yah·weh dar·ḵê- ’îš gam- ’ō·wy·ḇāw yaš·lim ’it·tōw
verses.literal: When a man’s ways please the LORD He makes even the man’s enemies live at peace with him
verses.literalPt: Sendo os caminhos do homem agradáveis ao SENHOR, até a seus inimigos faz que tenham paz com ele.

verses.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- mə·‘aṭ biṣ·ḏā·qāh mê·rōḇ tə·ḇū·’ō·wṯ bə·lō miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Better a little with righteousness than great gain with injustice . . .
verses.literalPt: Melhor é o pouco com justiça, do que a abundância de bens com injustiça.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ’ā·ḏām yə·ḥaš·šêḇ dar·kōw Yah·weh yā·ḵîn ṣa·‘ă·ḏōw
verses.literal: A man’s heart plans his course but the LORD determines his steps
verses.literalPt: O coração do homem planeja o seu caminho, mas o SENHOR lhe dirige os passos.

verses.original: קֶ֤סֶם׀ עַֽל־ שִׂפְתֵי־ מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־ פִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: qe·sem ‘al- śip̄·ṯê- me·leḵ bə·miš·pāṭ lō yim·‘al- pîw
verses.literal: A divine verdict is on the lips of a king his mouth must not betray justice
verses.literalPt: Nos lábios do rei se acha a sentença divina; a sua boca não transgride quando julga.

verses.original: פֶּ֤לֶס׀ וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל־ אַבְנֵי־ כִֽיס׃
verses.transliteration: pe·les ū·mō·zə·nê miš·pāṭ Yah·weh ma·‘ă·śê·hū kāl- ’aḇ·nê- ḵîs
verses.literal: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD all the weights in the bag are His concern
verses.literalPt: O peso e a balança justos são do SENHOR; obra sua são os pesos da bolsa.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ mə·lā·ḵîm ‘ă·śō·wṯ re·ša‘ kî ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh yik·kō·wn kis·sê
verses.literal: Wicked behavior is detestable for kings for a throne is established through righteousness
verses.literalPt: Abominação é aos reis praticarem impiedade, porque com justiça é que se estabelece o trono.

verses.original: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־ צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ṣō·wn mə·lā·ḵîm śip̄·ṯê- ṣe·ḏeq wə·ḏō·ḇêr yə·šā·rîm ye·’ĕ·hāḇ
verses.literal: Righteous lips are a king’s delight and he who speaks honestly is beloved
verses.literalPt: Os lábios de justiça são o contentamento dos reis; eles amarão o que fala coisas retas.

verses.original: חֲמַת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־ מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·maṯ- me·leḵ mal·’ă·ḵê- mā·weṯ wə·’îš ḥā·ḵām yə·ḵap·pə·ren·nāh
verses.literal: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death but a wise man will pacify it
verses.literalPt: O furor do rei é mensageiro da morte, mas o homem sábio o apaziguará.

verses.original: בְּאוֹר־ פְּנֵי־ מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ō·wr- pə·nê- me·leḵ ḥay·yîm ū·rə·ṣō·w·nōw kə·‘āḇ mal·qō·wōš
verses.literal: When a king’s face brightens there is life his favor is like a rain cloud in spring
verses.literalPt: No semblante iluminado do rei está a vida, e a sua benevolência é como a nuvem da chuva serôdia.

verses.original: קְֽנֹה־ חָכְמָ֗ה מַה־ טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: qə·nōh- ḥāḵ·māh mah- ṭō·wḇ mê·ḥā·rūṣ ū·qə·nō·wṯ bî·nāh niḇ·ḥār mik·kā·sep̄
verses.literal: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold To gain understanding is more desirable than silver
verses.literalPt: Quão melhor é adquirir a sabedoria do que o ouro! e quão mais excelente é adquirir a prudência do que a prata!

verses.original: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·sil·laṯ yə·šā·rîm sūr mê·rā‘ šō·mêr nap̄·šōw nō·ṣêr dar·kōw
verses.literal: The highway of the upright leads away from evil he who guards his way protects his life
verses.literalPt: Os retos fazem o seu caminho desviar-se do mal; o que guarda o seu caminho preserva a sua alma.

verses.original: לִפְנֵי־ שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê- še·ḇer gā·’ō·wn wə·lip̄·nê ḵiš·šā·lō·wn gō·ḇah rū·aḥ
verses.literal: Pride goes before destruction and a haughty spirit before a fall
verses.literalPt: A soberba precede a ruína, e a altivez do espírito precede a queda.

verses.original: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ ר֭וּחַ אֶת־ עֲנִיִּים מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־ גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ šə·p̄al- rū·aḥ ’eṯ- ʿă·nī·yīm mê·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl ’eṯ- gê·’îm
verses.literal: It is better to be lowly in spirit among the humble than to divide the spoil with the proud
verses.literalPt: Melhor é ser humilde de espírito com os mansos, do que repartir o despojo com os soberbos.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־ דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl ‘al- dā·ḇār yim·ṣā- ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh ’aš·rāw
verses.literal: Whoever heeds . . . instruction will find success and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD
verses.literalPt: O que atenta prudentemente para o assunto achará o bem, e o que confia no SENHOR será bem-aventurado.

verses.original: לַחֲכַם־ לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.transliteration: la·ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ yiq·qā·rê nā·ḇō·wn ū·me·ṯeq śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim yō·sîp̄ le·qaḥ
verses.literal: The wise in heart are called discerning and pleasant speech promotes instruction
verses.literalPt: O sábio de coração será chamado prudente, e a doçura dos lábios aumentará o ensino.

verses.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qō·wr ḥay·yîm śê·ḵel bə·‘ā·lāw ū·mū·sar ’ĕ·wi·lîm ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor but the discipline of fools is folly
verses.literalPt: O entendimento para aqueles que o possuem, é uma fonte de vida, mas a instrução dos tolos é a sua estultícia.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל־ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ḥā·ḵām yaś·kîl pî·hū wə·‘a·lś- śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw yō·sîp̄ le·qaḥ
verses.literal: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips
verses.literalPt: O coração do sábio instrui a sua boca, e aumenta o ensino dos seus lábios.

verses.original: צוּף־ דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי־ נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣūp̄- də·ḇaš ’im·rê- nō·‘am mā·ṯō·wq lan·ne·p̄eš ū·mar·pê lā·‘ā·ṣem
verses.literal: Pleasant words are a honeycomb . . . sweet to the soul and healing to the bones
verses.literalPt: As palavras suaves são favos de mel, doces para a alma, e saúde para os ossos.

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: yêš de·reḵ yā·šār lip̄·nê- ’îš wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh dar·ḵê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: There is a way that seems right to a man but its end is the way of death
verses.literalPt: Há um caminho que parece direito ao homem, mas o seu fim são os caminhos da morte.

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš ‘ā·mêl ‘ā·mə·lāh lōw kî- ’ā·ḵap̄ ‘ā·lāw pî·hū
verses.literal: A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward
verses.literalPt: O trabalhador trabalha para si mesmo, porque a sua boca o incita.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־ שְׂפָתָיו כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš bə·lî·ya·‘al kō·reh rā·‘āh wə·‘al- śə·p̄å̄·ṯå̄w kə·’êš ṣā·rā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: A worthless man digs up evil and his speech is like a scorching fire
verses.literalPt: O homem ímpio cava o mal, e nos seus lábios há como que uma fogueira.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ yə·šal·laḥ mā·ḏō·wn wə·nir·gå̄n map̄·rîḏ ’al·lūp̄
verses.literal: A perverse man spreads dissension and a gossip divides close friends
verses.literalPt: O homem perverso instiga a contenda, e o intrigante separa os maiores amigos.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ḥā·mās yə·p̄at·teh rê·‘ê·hū wə·hō·w·lî·ḵōw bə·ḏe·reḵ lō- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good
verses.literalPt: O homem violento coage o seu próximo, e o faz deslizar por caminhos nada bons.

verses.original: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ṣeh ‘ê·nāw laḥ·šōḇ tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ qō·rêṣ śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw kil·lāh rā·‘āh
verses.literal: He who winks his eye devises perversity he who purses his lips is bent on evil
verses.literalPt: O que fecha os olhos para imaginar coisas ruins, ao cerrar os lábios pratica o mal.

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ śê·ḇāh bə·ḏe·reḵ ṣə·ḏā·qāh tim·mā·ṣê
verses.literal: Gray hair is a crown of glory it is attained along the path of righteousness
verses.literalPt: Coroa de honra são as cãs, quando elas estão no caminho da justiça.

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim mig·gib·bō·wr ū·mō·šêl bə·rū·ḥōw mil·lō·ḵêḏ ‘îr
verses.literal: He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior and he who controls his temper is greater than one who captures a city
verses.literalPt: Melhor é o que tarda em irar-se do que o poderoso, e o que controla o seu ânimo do que aquele que toma uma cidade.

verses.original: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־ הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל־ מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥêq yū·ṭal ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·rāl Yah·weh kāl- miš·pā·ṭōw
verses.literal: The lot is cast into the lap but its every decision is from the LORD
verses.literalPt: A sorte se lança no regaço, mas do SENHOR procede toda a determinação.
